claims: Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars.
The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for his role as Col. Steven J. Lockjaw in One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn's win marks his third Academy Award win.
Sean Penn did not attend the 2026 Oscars ceremony.
Reports suggest Sean Penn was traveling for activist duties.
